newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Congo Brazzaville shell lands in Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Congo Brazzaville shell lands in Kinshasa.

text.p: A shell fired during fighting between the army and political militias in Congo Brazzaville landed near the centre of Kinshasa, the capital of the neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo, business sources said.
The sources said the shell exploded near the ministry of planning at around 1.05 p.m. (1205 GMT).
"We don't think there were any dead or wounded," said one source near the scene.

Brazzaville, where fighting rages between troops loyal to President Pascal Lissouba and a political militia loyal to ex-president Denis Sassou Nguesso, is less than three km (two miles) from Kinshasa across the Congo river.
Last month President Laurent Kabila's forces drove Mobutu Sese Seko from Kinshasa and renamed the former Zaire the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
